$comment: Configuration for the VelvetRP stock-model baseline workstation. Edit paths here; scripts never hard-code machine-specific locations. All paths may contain spaces.

llamaServer.ctxRationale: VelvetRP adventure-planning prompts measured 10,000-24,400 tokens during the 18-turn free-form run, so the 4096 default caused HTTP 400 context overflow on 40 of 58 provider calls. 16384 with a q8_0 KV cache fits the 5.03 GiB Q4_K_M weights plus KV into the ~7 GiB free on this 8 GiB card. q8_0 rather than q4_0 is deliberate: llama.cpp warns that heavy KV quantisation degrades tool-calling quality, which is exactly the capability under test.

models.notes: Official Qwen GGUF. Uses an embedded qwen3 chat template with native tool support.

huggingface.source: upstream safetensors; converted locally (no third-party v1.3 GGUF exists)

models.notes: Roleplay-tuned Llama 3.1 8B. Converted from upstream safetensors with llama.cpp b11574 convert_hf_to_gguf + imatrix-free Q4_K_M. All four source shards verified against HF content-addressed blob ids. Uses the Llama 3.1 chat template, so unlike Qwen3 it has no hybrid-reasoning budget problem; named-tool-call behaviour should differ.

huggingface.source: unsloth GGUF; hybrid linear/full attention (8 full-attn of 32 layers)

models.notes: Re-baseline candidate for the forced-tool-adherence probe. Hybrid architecture, so full-attention KV at 24576 is ~0.38 GiB vs 1.69 GiB for Qwen3-8B. mmproj held on CPU via --no-mmproj-offload to protect VRAM; reasoning disabled via --chat-template-kwargs.
